title: TU Ilmenau
description: A small technical university in the Thuringian forest with strong engineering and computer science programmes, several taught in English.
html:
Admission

TU Ilmenau offers bachelor's programmes mostly in German and a range of English-taught master's programmes in electrical engineering, computer science, media technology and mechanical engineering. Admission to the master's programmes requires a relevant bachelor's degree, an English certificate and, for some programmes, a minimum grade. Applications for the winter semester close in spring for non-EU applicants.

Campus

The campus is compact and modern, with well-equipped laboratories, a large library, sports facilities and a student club scene that is unusually active for a town of 40,000. Almost everything is within walking or cycling distance.

Accommodation

Student residences run by the student services organisation are plentiful and cheap by German standards, with rooms from around €250 a month, and most international students get a place. Private rooms in the town are also affordable.

The town

Ilmenau sits in the Thuringian forest, with hiking and skiing on the doorstep and Erfurt, the state capital, 45 minutes away. Living costs are among the lowest of any university town in Germany, which makes the €992 monthly budget of the visa go a long way.
